answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 13678 Country: India Title: CAN I GIVE ZAQAT TO OTHER THAN MUSLIMS? Question: CAN I GIVE ZAQAT TO OTHER THAN MUSLIMS? Answer ID: 13678 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 940/940=M/1430) It is impermissible to give Zakah to a non-Muslim: وأما أھل الذمۃ فلا یجوز صرف الزکاۃ إلیھم بالاتفاق (عالمگیري ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
